key.name: last-page
key.description: The sidebar item that was selected when the window closed: a destination's key, or "playlist:ID" or "folder:ID" for one of the library's playlists or folders.

key.name: expanded-folders
key.description: The ids of the playlist folders shown open in the sidebar, their contents listed under them.

key.name: background-playback
key.summary: Keep playing when the window is closed
key.description: Whether closing the window while something plays hides it and lets the music play on, the system's media controls bringing the window back; the app quits once playback stops. Off, closing the window quits the app and stops the engine.

key.name: browser-command
key.description: The program that runs Google Chrome, the playback engine: a name on PATH or an absolute path, without arguments (it must be the real Chrome: it ships Widevine). When it is not found, google-chrome-stable, google-chrome and /opt/google/chrome/chrome are tried.

key.name: engine-headless
key.description: Whether Chrome runs without a window once signed in, from the next engine start. Off, the Chrome window stays visible after signing in and whenever the engine starts, which helps debugging.

key.name: engine-autostart
key.description: Whether the engine is started when the app starts and the account is signed in (headless unless engine-headless is off).

key.name: signed-in
key.description: Whether the engine's Chrome profile holds an Apple Music sign-in; set by signing in and cleared by signing out.

key.name: account-name
key.description: The name shown on the account button, read from the Apple Music page after signing in; empty when none could be read.

key.name: last-sync
key.summary: When the library was last synced
key.description: The time the library was last fetched from Apple Music in full, as an ISO 8601 timestamp; empty before the first sync.

key.name: signed-in-devel
key.summary: Signed in to Apple Music, for the development build's own Chrome profile
key.description: As signed-in, for the development build (-Dprofile=development), whose Chrome profile and cache are its own.

key.name: account-name-devel
key.summary: Account display name, for the development build's own Chrome profile
key.description: As account-name, for the development build.

key.name: last-sync-devel
key.summary: When the library was last synced, for the development build's own cache
key.description: As last-sync, for the development build.

key.name: last-page-devel
key.summary: Last page shown, for the development build's own library
key.description: As last-page, for the development build.

key.name: expanded-folders-devel
key.summary: Expanded playlist folders, for the development build's own library
key.description: As expanded-folders, for the development build.

key.name: sync-interval
key.description: While the app runs, the library is synced again whenever the last sync is older than this many hours and the engine is running and signed in (it is not started for a sync). 0 syncs only when asked (Refresh Library). A library missing or damaged on disk is synced as soon as the engine is up, whatever this says.
